name: snowlog
description: SnowLog web and Capacitor iOS application

scripts.test: node dashboard-calculations.test.js && node backup-compatibility.test.js && node workout-regression.test.js && node timer-regression.test.js
scripts.build:web: mkdir -p dist/icons dist/sounds && cp index.html backup.js workout-utils.js manifest.webmanifest sw.js dist/ && cp icons/* dist/icons/ && cp sounds/* dist/sounds/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
